title: Mass of a Helical Wire with Linearly Increasing Density
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Find the mass of a thin wire shaped like the circular helix r(t) = <cos(t), sin(t), t> for 0 <= t <= 2*pi with linear density delta(x, y, z) = z.

steps.title: Compute Speed and Arc Length Differential
steps.explanation: Compute the norm of the velocity vector.

steps.title: Integrate Density Along the Helix
steps.explanation: Substitute z(t) = t and evaluate polynomial integral.
